parts.name: Lid
parts.Basic_description: The lid is the top covering part of the pot, made of ceramic, shaped to fit snugly on the container.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover the pot, preserving heat and preventing contents from spilling or contamination.
parts.Movement_description: It can be lifted or rotated slightly to open or close the pot.

parts.name: Container
parts.Basic_description: The container is the main body of the pot, made of ceramic, with a curved shape for holding liquids or solids.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the contents of the pot, providing the main storage volume.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, though it can be lifted or tilted when pouring.

parts.name: Bottom
parts.Basic_description: The bottom is the base part of the pot, made of ceramic, providing stability and support.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the pot and ensures it stands upright on flat surfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It does not move independently; it remains fixed as the base of the pot.
